headline: Iran Missile Launches, Hormuz Tanker Fires Escalate as Israel Strikes Gaza, Lebanon
subheadline: IRGC Navy reports two tankers caught fire after hitting naval mines in Strait of Hormuz as Iran fires missiles from Bandar Lengeh.
lede: Iran launched multiple missiles from Bandar Lengeh and toward the Strait of Hormuz and a UAV from Omidiyeh Air Base, while the IRGC Navy reported two tankers caught fire after hitting naval mines in the Strait. An IDF drone strike with four missiles killed Rafah Brigade commander Abu Younis in a displaced persons tent in Al-Mawasi, west of Khan Yunis, and Israeli artillery shelled four locations in southern Lebanon. Russian forces launched Geran-5 missiles and Shahed drones from Orel, Kursk, Bryansk, the Black Sea and occupied territories against at least 14 Ukrainian oblasts overnight, causing 22 injuries in Zaporizhzhia and two deaths in Chernihiv's Mena. Ukrainian deep strikes damaged the Samara oil hub and Lipetsk-2 airfield command post as ballistic missile threats to energy infrastructure were extended 48 hours.

sections.title: Mass Russian Strikes Hit 14 Ukrainian Regions
sections.body: Russian forces launched Geran-5 missiles and Shahed drones from Orel, Kursk, Bryansk, the Black Sea and occupied territories against at least 14 Ukrainian oblasts overnight November 14-15. Ukrainian air defenses intercepted multiple targets over Kyiv during an air raid alert from 01:18 to 03:30 on November 15. Strikes wounded 22 people in Zaporizhzhia, including three children aged 6 months, 2 and 12 years, and killed two men aged 42 and 45 in Mena, Chernihiv region, injuring one 33-year-old. Ukrainian deep strikes damaged the Samara oil facility handling 50% of Russia's export blend and the Lipetsk-2 airfield command post, while a ballistic missile threat targeting energy infrastructure in Kyiv, Poltava, Kharkiv and Dnipropetrovsk regions was extended 48 hours.

sections.title: Iran Escalates Hormuz as Israel Strikes Gaza, Lebanon
sections.body: An IDF drone strike with four missiles killed Rafah Brigade commander Abu Younis in a displaced persons tent in Al-Mawasi, west of Khan Yunis. Iran conducted multiple missile launches from Bandar Lengeh and toward the Strait of Hormuz, plus a UAV launch from Omidiyeh Air Base. Israeli artillery shelled Wadi Al-Salouqi, Wadi Nahla, Zibqin and Wadi Al-Hajir in southern Lebanon, while warplanes operated over southern Lebanon and dropped flares over Shama. The IRGC Navy reported two tankers caught fire after hitting naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: Iran's simultaneous missile launches from Bandar Lengeh and toward the Strait of Hormuz, coupled with UAV deployment from Omidiyeh, signal a coordinated escalation in maritime and aerial posture. The IRGC Navy report of two tankers caught fire after naval mine strikes directly threatens global energy transit, while Israel's artillery campaign in southern Lebanon and precision drone strike in Gaza reflect sustained high-tempo operations across fronts. The convergence of Iranian proxy activity in Iraq with direct Iranian kinetic actions suggests an integrated pressure campaign.
